Container.Name: Antigravity-Daemon
Container.Overview: A headless Docker wrapper for the Google Antigravity CLI, designed to run as a persistent remote-control daemon.

Config.Name: Appdata Config
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the agent's OAuth tokens and logs.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: The primary folder where the agent will view and edit files.

Config.Name: Doppler Token
Config.Description: Optional: Doppler Service Token to inject secrets into the agent's environment.

Config.Name: Instance Name
Config.Description: Optional: Locks the remote-control session to a specific name. Prevents offline 'ghost' instances from being created when the container updates.
